Commentary.Commentary: So, we now know who the four semi-finalists are, India join England, Australia and Afghanistan. It is going to be India against Australia and England will be taking on Afghanistan. The first of the semi-finals will be played on the 1st of February and that is between England and Afghanistan. It begins at 1830 IST (1300 GMT). The build-up though begins a lot earlier. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Yash Dhull, the skipper of India Under-19, says their team combination is great and the atmosphere in the dressing room is good. Mentions it has been a good experience and they try to learn from every game. Adds they will think about the next game on the day of the match.

Bangladesh Under-19 skipper, Rakibul Hasan says the toss decided the game, the wicket was not easy first up and the opposition bowlers took advantage. States that they could have been a little cautious at the start with the bat. Ends by saying the wicket was tough but they did well and they are now looking forward to the next games.

PLAYER OF THE MATCH, Ravi Kumar, says the plan was simple, he only wanted to hit the right lines and lengths, they have played with them before and they just wanted to create pressure. States 8 days of rest was good, they spent time together and had good practice sessions. Informs the experience has been great and he has enjoyed his time.
Time for the Presentation...

Bangladesh can be pleased with the fact that they did not make it easy for the Indians. They really made them work hard for their runs. The new ball bowlers were really good, beat the bat several times, they just did not have a lot of luck on their side. Ripon Mondol impressed one and many and was the pick of the bowlers with a four-fer. Bangladesh though just did not have enough runs on the board. Maybe another 40 or 50 runs and it could have gone either way.

In reply though, India lost a wicket with no runs on the board. However, then there was a good stand between Angkrish Raghuvanshi and Shaik Rasheed. The two added 70 and settled all the nerves if there were any. India did lose a few more wickets after that but the skipper, Yash Dhull held fort at one end and took his side over the line.

A very convincing win for India and they march into the semi finals becoming the 4th and the final team to do so! It was not as easy as we thought it would be but still, it was a game they thoroughly dominated. First it was their bowlers, a combined effort saw them bundle Bangladesh out for a very low score.

SIX! That's it, India Under-19 are in the semi-finals and Kaushal Tambe has finished things off in style! The defending champions have been knocked out! Tossed up, around middle and leg. Tambe gets the front leg out of the way and smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie. INDIA WIN BY 5 WICKETS!
Tambe looks to make room leg side but Hasan slides one into leg stump. Tambe keeps it out on the leg side.
On middle. Blocked out.
Tossed up, around off. Tambe works it towards cover.
Very full, outside off. This is squeezed towards point.
Scores are level now! On middle and leg, this is flicked towards square leg for a single.
Short this time, angling down leg. Dhull pulls it behind square for a single.
Full and straight, Dhull drives it towards mid on. Bangladesh not letting India get the final runs easily here. That's good competitive spirit.
Pitched up, on off. This is pushed towards mid off.
A short ball, around off. This is pulled along the ground and towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Tambe gets right behind the line of the ball to block.
Tossed up, on off. Dhull strides forward to defend.
On off. Blocked out.
Angled into middle and leg. Dhull works it towards mid-wicket.
On middle. This is pushed back towards the bowlers.
Nicely flighted, around off. Dhull strides out and edges it past the slip cordon.
Around off. Tambe goes deep and plays it towards cover for a quick single.
FOUR! Gorgeous shot! A touch short and wide, Yash Dhull hops on the back foot and works it through cover-point for a boundary.

DRINKS! Well then, just the 5 runs required now and India should seal the deal in the next few minutes. But all credit goes to Bangladesh as they have a made real match out of this time. India have always remained on top but Bangladesh have done enough to make the Indian batters stay on their toes. The skipper, Yash Dhull has kept his calm and looks to be guiding his side into the semi-finals.
WIDE! Short again and the ball yet again bounces over the bowler's head. Just 9 required now.
Around off, this is pushed towards cover.
WIDE! Down the leg side this time. Back-to-back wides.
WIDE! Banged in short, this one goes way over the batter's head. A wide is called.
Back of a length, angling in. This is tucked away to mid-wicket.
Very slow, wide outside off. Dhull waits for it and slaps it straight towards point.
short and wide, this is played off the back foot towards backward point.
Short ball, on the body. Dhull manages to fend it away.
A touch short and wide, this is cut away towards cover-point.
quicker and flatter, around off. This is dabbed down past the first slip.
Tossed up, around off. Tambe presses forward to defend.
On off. Blocked out.
shorter, on off. This is punched down to long off for a single. The 100 is up for India.
On a length, around off. Tambe guides it towards short third man for a quick single.
Well fielded! Short and wide, Dhull hops and dabs it down towards backward point. The fielder over there puts in the dive to stop the run.
A length ball, around off. Tambe looks to drive but gets an inside edge past the stumps towards short fine leg. They get a single.
Another short one, on the body. Tambe manages to fend it away.
A short ball, over middle and leg. Tambe ducks under it.
A length ball, around off. Tambe shuffles across to defend.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! He's got him down the leg side and Raj Angad Bawa departs for a duck! Back of a length, around leg. Bawa gets into a tangle as he looks to tuck it away leg side. He ends up getting a faint tickle on it. Md Fahim takes a simple catch behind the stumps and Ripon Mondol has a well-deserved fourth wicket. Just some nerves creeping in as India look to close the game out. Kaushal Tambe is in at number 7.
Commentary.Howout: c Md Fahim b Ripon Mondol

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Best of the lot! Full and around off. Yash Dhull leans into the cover drive and creams it through extra cover for a third boundary in the over.

Brilliant effort from the keeper. Back of a length, sliding down leg. Dhull gets a tickle on it but the keeper dives down to his left and makes the stop. He might have hurt himself a bit as well in the process.
FOUR! The skipper is in a hurry here. A length ball, outside off. Dhull taps it over cover-point and the ball races away into the fence for another boundary.

FOUR! Through the hands and races away into the fence. Full, outside off. Yash Dhull puts out a stride and creams the cover drive. The fielder at cover gets a bad bounce and the ball goes through his hands.
On off. Dhull taps it back onto the deck.
Lovely looking stroke! On a good length, outside off. Yash Dhull punches it on the up and gets it through cover. Rakibul Hasan gives chase and cuts it off. Two taken.
A slower short ball, angled across off. Bawa lets it through to the keeper.
Around the top of middle. Bawa defends it out.
Full, around middle and leg. This is pushed towards mid on.
On off. Blocked out.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Bawa misses the flick. Wided.
Raj Angad Bawa is in at number 6.

OUT! TAKEN! Sensational catch by Iftakhar Hossain and Ripon Mondol is wreaking havoc here! With just 30 required to win, Siddharth Yadav tries to be a bit too aggressive and pays the price. Back of a length, around off. Yadav hangs back and looks to force it over extra cover. He doesn't quite get a good connection as the ball comes off the splice of the bat but seems to be going over the fielder's head. Hossain dives full stretch high and to his left to snatch it out of thin air and Ripon has his third wicket. Is the possibility of a miracle still on?
Commentary.Howout: c Iftakhar Hossain b Ripon Mondol

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, played towards point.
WIDE! Banged in short, down the leg side. Wided.
Full and wide, Dhull steps out looking to play the cover drive but gets it off the toe end of the bat.
On off. Blocked out.
Well bowled and well played! A yorker. This is tailing in on off stump. Dhull jams it out towards point.
Back of a length, around leg. Yadav rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Slower one, angled across off. This is nudged towards point.

Fullish delivery, around leg. Yadav defend it back to the bowler. There's a bit of a dialogue between the batter and the bowler. Both running a bit high on emotion probably. Shades of the final from 2 years back but they need to be careful as well not to cross the line.
Back of a length, sliding down leg. Yash Dhull looks to step out of the crease but shoulders arms in the end and the ball hits him on the body.
Banged in short, on middle. Yadav looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the shoulder. The ball goes back onto the deck but Dhull shows great awareness to call his partner for a quick single.
FOUR! Short and wide and gets the treatment it deserved. Yadav hops and throws his hands at it. The ball flies down to the left of third man and goes into the boundary.
Around the top of off. This is pushed towards cover.
Back of a length, around leg. Yadav defends it out.
Siddharth Yadav comes in to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! TAKEN! Beautifully bowled and Ripon Mondol has his second wicket! On a length, this is angled into off stump. The ball just nips away enough after pitching and gets the outside edge of Shaik Rasheed's bat. The keeper Md Fahim dives brilliantly to his right to take a sharp catch. Both set batters have been dismissed now and Ripon is on a hat-trick!
Commentary.Howout: c Md Fahim b Ripon Mondol

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter, on off. Rasheed works it through cover for a single. 37 required now off 29 overs.
Brilliant fielding! Down the leg side, Rasheed sweeps it hard and towards short fine leg. The fielder over there dives to his right and saves a certain boundary.
FOUR! Short and wide, Shaik Rasheed rocks back and latches onto it in a flash. He then slaps it in front of square on the off side and picks up a boundary.
Flatter, on middle. Rasheed backs away and works it on the off side.
Around middle and leg. Rasheed defends it out.
On a length, around leg. Blocked out.

OUT! TAKEN! No fifty for Angkrish Raghuvanshi! This is short and wide, Raghuvanshi hops to try and get on top of the bounce. He hits it hard but just can't get it high over the point fielder. Prantik Nawrose Nabil over there leaps up and takes a very sharp catch. The ball was travelling to be honest and Ripon Mondol has a wicket to his name. Also, Yash Dhull is at the crease now.
Commentary.Howout: c Prantik Nawrose Nabil b Ripon Mondol

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Good effort in the field! Another short ball, on the body. Raghuvanshi pulls it hard and flat, towards fine leg. The fielder over there dives to his left but can't get to the ball. It goes one bounce and into the fence.

A lot of hesitation out there in the middle. This is banged in short, around off. Rasheed plays a controlled pull shot towards deep mid-wicket. Raghuvanshi wants the single but Rasheed sends him back and rightly so. The keeper tries to whip off the bails but misses and they look for the overthrow which isn't there.
A length ball, angled in from around off. Rasheed defends it out.
Short ball, over middle. Rasheed ducks under it.
FOUR! A low full toss, on middle. Shaik Rasheed punches it beautifully towards the right of mid on and the ball races away into the fence.
Shorter and around leg. Rasheed goes back in his crease to work it towards deep mid-wicket for one more.
Full, on middle. Raghuvanshi wrists it through mid-wicket for a run.
On off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Probably the shot of the day! Tossed up, around off. Raghuvanshi goes inside-out over extra cover and picks up a boundary.
Around leg again, Rasheed works it on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up, on a length and around leg. Rasheed strides out to defend.
Very full, angled into middle and leg. This is nicely driven but straight towards mid on again.
Full and straight. This is driven straight to mid on.
Another bumper, outside off. Raghuvanshi moves away from the line of the ball.
Short again, on the body. Rasheed pulls it down to deep square leg for one.
A good short ball, around off. Rasheed sways his head away from the line of the ball.
Pitched up, around off. Rasheed gets right behind the line of the ball to block.
Ripon Mondol (2-1-3-0) is back into the attack.
Quicker one, fired into middle. Raghuvanshi blocks it out.
On off. This is driven towards the cover region.
Around off and sharp turn on offer. Raghuvanshi is beaten once again.
Nicely bowled! Lovely flight and drift, around off. Raghuvanshi looks to block but the ball turns and beats him on the outside edge.
On off. This is defended off the front foot.
Around middle and leg. Rasheed works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Beaten! A touch fuller, around off. Raghuvanshi has a poke at it but the ball zips past the outside edge.
WIDE! Good bumper but it's just a bit too high. Wide signalled.
FOUR! The runs are flowing now. A length ball, around off. Raghuvanshi drives on the up and gets it through cover for another boundary. The fifty is also up for India.
Well bowled! Fuller, outside off. Raghuvanshi looks to drive but gets beaten.
FOUR! This time Raghuvanshi has hit it well in front of square and will pick up the boundary. This is dug in short and Raghuvanshi pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

Well played and well fielded. Shorter one, but a bit slower in pace. Raghuvanshi waits for it and rolls his wrists over the pull shot and hits it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs around from deep backward square leg and keeps it down to a couple.
Fuller in length, angling in from around off. Raghuvanshi blocks it out.
On middle, blocked.
Three now! On off, the reverse sweep is out, it is played through point for three.
On the stumps, defended.
A single as this is pushed down to long on.
On middle, blocked.
FOUR! Short and pulled away! On middle, this is hit through square leg for a boundary.

DRINKS! Well, the Bangladesh bowlers have done really well to get that early wicket and keep things tight here. It has been really slow going for Raghuvanshi and Rasheed, especially for the latter but they know that the more time they spend at the crease, the easier it becomes. 79 runs needed off 36 overs and with 9 wickets in hand, India will still feel really comfortable.
On off, defended.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed wide of mid off for one.
WIDE! Short but well over the batter's head! Ducked under.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled towards deep square leg for one.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
On off, defended.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, blocked.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed towards cover, the fielder over there dives and stops it.
Outside off, left alone.
That is a beauty! Bangladesh feel there is an edge but not given. On off, this lands and spins away. Rasheed looks to defend but is beaten.
Outside off, left alone.
Rakibul Hasan is bringing in silly point. Bangladesh do needs wickets and they are now getting extra catchers in place.
On off, kept out.
Outside off, the batter looks to drive, this one flies off the outside edge down to third man for one.
On off, this is kept out well.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
BEATEN! A good nut! Outside off, Angkrish Raghuvanshi looks to push at it but is beaten.
On middle, kept out.
On the stumps, blocked.
Outside off, left alone.
Another one on the stumps, blocked.
On the stumps, defended well.
Flatter and on the stumps, kept out.
On middle, defended.

The umpire signals the start of Powerplay 2 which will go on from overs 11-40. The fielding side can now have upto 4 fielders outside the 30-yard circle. Also, the skipper, Rakibul Hasan brings himself into the attack now.
A loud appeal! This lands on off and jags back in. The batter looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
Shorter in length and on middle, this is pulled over mid-wicket for two.
On off, defended.
Another delivery outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Put away! Short and wide outside off, it is cut away through point and this one races away to the fence.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Angkrish Raghuvanshi looks to flick but misses. Wided.

Good running! On the pads, this is flicked through square leg and the batters push hard for two. They get it with ease but Rasheed seems to be hobbling a bit. The physio is out once again and he is having a look at Rasheed, who seems to be suffering from cramps.
Right around the top of off. Rasheed keeps it down towards backward point.
Around the hips. Raghuvanshi knocks it 'round the corner for a single.
Nicely driven but straight to the fielder. Full and wide, Raghuvanshi drives it on the up but straight to point.
Fullish ball, angled into middle and leg. Raghuvanshi defends it out.
On off. Kept out towards point.
Beaten! This is pitched up, outside off. It seems to be nipping back in but the ball just holds its line. Rasheed looks to block but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Very full, on off. Rasheed drives it straight towards mid off.
A good-length ball, on off. Rasheed defends it out.
Around off, this is tapped towards cover-point.
Back of a length, nipping back in from outside off. Raghuvanshi manages to guide it down towards third man for a single.
A length ball, around off. Raghuvanshi presses forward and bunts it on the off side.
Length, pushed wider. Rasheed makes another leave. Ripon Mondol starts off with a maiden.
Bowled into the channel outside off and left alone.
A bit of an extra bounce here! On a good length, angled in from around off. Shaik Rasheed is taken aback by the extra bounce but does well to fend it away.
Sent back again by Raghuvanshi. A length ball, around off. Rasheed drops it on the off side and looks for the single which isn't there.
Around the top of off. This edged down to point with soft hands.
Pitched up, in that channel around off. Rasheed leaves it alone.
Ripon Mondol is into the attack now.
FOUR! Here comes the boundary. Short of a length, on middle. Raghuvanshi hangs deep and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Sakib is keeping the batters on their toes here. On a good length, close to the off pole. Raghuvanshi looks to punch it on the off side but gets an inside edge past the leg stump.
Around off. Kept out on the off side.

Miscued but safe! Angling into middle and leg, Raghuvanshi looks to whip it across but ends up getting it off the toe end of the bat. The ball pops up and lands just in front of mid on. Ripon Mondol puts in the dive but can't get to it. The batters take two.
On off. Blokced out.

Shaik Rasheed is sent back and rightly so. Good-length ball, around off. Raghuvanshi drops it on the off side and calls for no pretty early. Rasheed is backing up well outside the crease and is lucky to get back in time.
WIDE! A length ball, sliding down the leg side. Wided.
Very full, on middle. Raghuvanshi punches it past mid on for a couple.
Good running! Full and straight, pushed towards mid on for a quick single.
Almost chopped on! Back of a length, outside off. Raghuvanshi doesn't move his feet as he looks to punch this one off the back foot. He gets an inside edge back onto the pads.
Pitched up, outside off. Raghuvanshi shoulders arms.
WIDE! Attempted slower short ball, down the leg side. Wided.

Edgy! Angled into middle and leg, Rasheed looks to work it leg side. He closes the face of the bat early and gets a leading edge towards cover. They scamper through for one and Rasheed id off the mark.
On a good length, close to off stump. Rasheed defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length, around off. Raghuvanshi pulls it stylishly but straight towards mid on.

Angkrish Raghuvanshi is down in some pain here. He is hit in the groin region and is lying flat on the ground now. The physio is out to have a look. Raghuvanshi seems good to continue and play will resume.
A huge appeal but turned down! Too high! On off, this one jags back in, it landed behind a length. Angkrish Raghuvanshi is hit near the box. An appeal but turned down.
On off, this is guided to point.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Sheer timing! Outside off, this is guided through point for a boundary.
Sharp movement! This lands outside off, this jags back in. Angkrish Raghuvanshi looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Really full and on middle, Rasheed works it to mid-wicket.
On off, this is defended.
On the off pole, Rasheed plays it to point.

There is an issue with the bowler's landing area and MD Ashiqur Zaman explains it to the umpire. The groundstaff are actually having their Lunch at the moment and a bit of sawdust or something to smooth out the rough edges is needed. A groundstaff races onto the pitch with something that looks like a hammer with a flat base and thumps it on the deck to get that area smoothened out. Well, after a bit of a delay, we are ready to resume play.
India are underway! On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
BEATEN! This is really good from the Bangladesh opening bowlers! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Angkrish Raghuvanshi is beaten as he tries to defend.
Back of a length and on off, blocked.
A wicket maiden! Outside off, left alone.
On off, blocked.
On middle, defended.
Shaik Rasheed is in at number 3.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Bangladesh have an early wicket. They are absolutely delighted with it! Short and wide outside off, Singh slashes, the extra bounce takes the outside edge and it is taken by the keeper. Perfect start for Bangladesh. They are pumped up.
Commentary.Howout: c Md Fahim b Tanzim Hasan Sakib

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN! That is a beauty! Length and on off, this lands and the moves away. The batter is beaten as he tries to block.
On off, kept out.
Tanzim Hasan Sakib to take the other new ball.
On off, blocked.
A loud, loud appeal but turned down! On the pads, Angkrish Raghuvanshi looks to flick but it goes off the pads. The keeper takes it. He feels it is off the bat but umpire does not.
On middle, blocked.

Half an appeal but turned down! On middle, the batter looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad. A loud shout but turned down. Angkrish Raghuvanshi takes off but is sent back. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
BEATEN! Bangladesh need these deliveries to find the edge, they need luck on their side. Length and on off, it lands and moves away. The batter looks to defend but is beaten.
Starts off with one well outside off, left alone.
